panelUpdate.subtitleIdle: Comparing this install with the latest commit in the repository.
panelUpdate.restarting: The panel is restarting. This page will reload on its own.
panelUpdate.restartingPm2: PM2 is restarting the panel. This page will reload on its own.
panelUpdate.upToDate: You are on the latest version
panelUpdate.failedHint: GitHub code may already be pulled. The error log is below. If the panel is on the latest commit, you can close this window.
panelUpdate.closingHint: This tab will close. start.bat will open the panel when it is ready.

reason.not_git: In-app updates work from a git clone: start.bat on Windows or PM2 on Linux. For npx, install again with: npx blockmine
reason.no_git_binary: Git was not found. Install Git and start the panel again.
reason.dirty: Could not pull from GitHub: local files block the merge. Remove the conflicting edits and try again.
reason.wrong_branch: The panel is not on master/main. Switch to the default branch to update with the button.
reason.diverged: Local history has diverged from GitHub. A manual git pull is required.
reason.ahead: This copy is newer than GitHub.
